manifest.name: dsh-dev-plugins
manifest.description: Public DeepSeek Harness (dsh) dev plugins: non-localhost Web UI serving, browser notifications, workspace token statistics, browser control through a Chrome extension, and a newline-on-Enter composer, without patching the installed dsh.
manifest.author: shawn (https://github.com/0xshawn)

bundle.text:
# dsh-dev-plugins bundle patch. Applied after @deepseek-ai/dsh-base and
# @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app; the profile's own cordis.patch.yml still wins.
#
# 1. /api browser-trust fence authorities. The stock dsh-web-app row only keeps
#    the invocation's --trusted-host list. This layer appends the deployment
#    authorities from DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS (comma-separated bare
#    `host` or `host:port` values), so a proxy/tunnel deployment can declare its
#    browser-facing authority in the service environment instead of the command
#    line. `webRuntime` (0.2.0) already contains the bind-derived LAN literals
#    and the invocation's --trusted-host values, so it must win when present:
#    0.2.0 provides both services, and preferring `webStartup` there would drop
#    the LAN authorities. `webStartup` (0.2.1) is the fallback.
- id: connection
  config:
    trustedHosts: !!js "((ctx.get('webRuntime') ?? ctx.get('webStartup'))?.trustedHosts ?? []).concat((process.env.DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS ?? '').split(',').map((value) => value.trim()).filter((value) => value.length > 0))"

# 2. Host plugin: loopback page parity plus a pinned launch token. Its module
#    name resolves from the profile's node_modules like every out-of-tree row.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-dev-plugins
      name: dsh-dev-plugins

# 3. Browser-control bridge: the bundle's MCP server row. dsh-mcp-client spawns
#    the bridge on stdio and registers its tools as mcp__browser__*. The bridge
#    path resolves through the profile that holds this package, so the patch
#    works for any profile name and install location; `node` is the running dsh
#    interpreter. Set DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE=0, or turn off Browser control on the
#    plugin settings page, to make the bridge exit and keep the tools
#    unregistered; every other knob is an environment variable documented in
#    docs/browser-control-protocol.md.
- insert:
    - id: mcp-browser
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: browser
        transport: stdio
        command: !!js process.execPath
        args:
          - !!js "`${process.env.DSH_HOME ?? `${process.env.HOME}/.dsh`}/profiles/${process.env.DSH_PROFILE ?? 'web'}/node_modules/dsh-dev-plugins/bridge/index.js`"
        # dsh-mcp-client spawns stdio servers with a scrubbed environment, so
        # every documented bridge knob has to be forwarded explicitly.
        env:
          DSH_HOME: !!js process.env.DSH_HOME ?? ''
          DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE: !!js process.env.DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE ?? ''
          DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_PORT: !!js process.env.DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_PORT ?? ''
          DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_TOKEN: !!js process.env.DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_TOKEN ?? ''
          DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_HOME: !!js process.env.DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_HOME ?? ''
          DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_EXTENSION_ID: !!js process.env.DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_EXTENSION_ID ?? ''
          DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_UPLOAD_ROOTS: !!js process.env.DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_UPLOAD_ROOTS ?? ''
          DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DOWNLOAD_DIR: !!js process.env.DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DOWNLOAD_DIR ?? ''
          DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DISABLE: !!js process.env.DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DISABLE ?? ''
          DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_NETWORK_LIMIT: !!js process.env.DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_NETWORK_LIMIT ?? ''
        failOnStartupError: false
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000

readme.text:
[](./LICENSE)
[](./package.json)

A growing collection of plugins for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh), installed as one bundle. The current release serves the dsh Web UI through a **non-localhost authority** — a reverse proxy, SSH tunnel, or LAN address — without patching the installed dsh, and adds browser notifications, a workspace token-usage page, and a composer where Enter inserts a line break.

[中文文档](./README.zh-CN.md)
Stock `dsh web` is built for a browser on the same machine. Six things are missing or break when the browser reaches it through another authority:

| Problem | Stock dsh | This plugin |
|---|---|---|
| `/api` Host/Origin fence | accepts loopback, the listener's bind literal, and `--trusted-host` only; every RPC answers `403` for a proxy authority | appends `DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS` authorities to the same list (`--trusted-host` keeps working) |
| Page view (`connection.isLoopback`) | derived from `location.hostname`; a proxied page is treated as non-loopback, so on dsh 0.2.0 settings stay in process-local memory (`settings are unavailable in this browser` on the Models page) and on every version the host-document action is hidden | injects `__DSH_TRANSPORT__ = { ownsHost: true }`, the host-owned transport hook dsh already uses for its desktop shell, so authenticated pages report the loopback view |
| Launch token | random per process; the only way to find the login URL after a restart is the service log | pins `DSH_WEB_TOKEN` (or plugin config) across restarts |
| First login | opening the bare deployment URL answers a plain `401`, so the token must come from the printed `?token=` URL | serves an HTML token form on the bare URL (`loginPage`, default on) and feeds the submitted token back into the stock exchange |
| Backg

Authentication is unchanged: the browser still has to exchange the launch token for the signed, authority-bound session cookie, and the Host/Origin fence still runs before every `/api` request. This plugin removes deployment friction; it does not bypass access control.
```sh

readme.section: from GitHub (public repository, no build step)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/0xshawn/dsh-dev-plugins.git

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-dev-plugins
```

Restart `dsh web` afterwards — dsh loads bundles at boot. Verify the row is active:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A6 'dsh-dev-plugins'
```

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-dev-plugins`; the stock behaviour returns on the next restart.

> **Renamed in 0.5.0.** The package was `dsh-remote-access` before; the profile row and the environment variable are now `dsh-dev-plugins` and `DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS`. Remove the old row before adding this one, and rename the variable in the service environment.
If a deployment currently patches the installed dsh bundles (fixed launch token plus a forced loopback classification), the switch is:

1. Stop applying the patch in the installer; `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@<version>` no longer needs a follow-up patch step.
2. Install this bundle into the `web` profile (above) and restart `dsh web`.
3. Keep the deployment's `DSH_WEB_TOKEN`; it is read by the same name. Keep `--trusted-host` or move the authorities to `DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS`.
4. Confirm the startup line still prints the pinned token: `dsh web: ...?token=<same token>`.

| Variable | Value | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS` | comma-separated bare authorities, e.g. `dsh.example.com,dsh.example.com:8443` | appended to `--trusted-host`; a port-less entry matches any port |
| `DSH_WEB_TOKEN` | non-empty launch token | pins the login token; empty/unset keeps the random per-process token |

Both work in systemd `Environment=`/`EnvironmentFile=`, launchd `EnvironmentVariables`, Docker env, or a shell profile. Keep `--trusted-host` if you prefer flags; the expression appends the environment authorities to the invocation list. Note that a patch layer replaces the whole `connection.config`: if another layer (or a later profile patch) overrides `connection`, restate `trustedHosts` there — otherwise the environment authorities are dropped — and restate any other key you still need, such as `cookieMaxAgeDays` or `recovery`.

```sh
DSH_WEB_TOKEN="$(cat /etc/dsh/web-token)" \
DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS="dsh.example.com" \
dsh web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3080 --no-open
```

Malformed authorities (a scheme, path, userinfo, or zero-padded port) abort boot with the upstream validation error instead of being silently ignored.

Override the `dsh-dev-plugins` row in the profile patch (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`) for per-profile values:

```yaml
- id: dsh-dev-plugins
  config:
    # false keeps the stock per-authority page view.
    loopback: true

Settings → **Dev plugins** exposes the same switches with a form, so the values
can be changed without editing this file.

readme.section: First login without the token URL
readme.text:
An unauthenticated browser that opens the bare deployment URL gets a small
sign-in form instead of the plain `401`. The form submits the token back to the
relative index path (`GET ./?token=...`), so the stock token exchange, signed
cookie, proxy mount handling, and redirect to the clean URL all still apply. A
wrong token simply re-renders the form with an error; a valid token logs in.

readme.section: First login without the token URL
readme.text:
The form is served only when the request authority already passes the
deployment's Host/Origin fence (loopback, the bind literal, or a
`DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS`/`--trusted-host` authority). An untrusted
authority keeps the plain `401`, so a DNS-rebinding or foreign host cannot
collect the token. The token still travels in the query string exactly like the
printed URL, and it remains the only credential; the form does not introduce a
second password store or a bypass. Set `loginPage: false` to restore the stock
`401` if a deployment fronting the port has its own login page.

See upstream [Publish the Web UI behind a reverse proxy](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/user/guide/public-deployments.md) for the full checklist. TLS termination, network isolation, and who may reach the port remain the operator's job.

The bundle also ships a browser client half (plain hand-written bundle, no build
step). It watches the Session status source and raises a Web Notification when:

Failures are read from the forwarded `api-session/error` event and paired with
the following idle transition, so a failed model call, aborted turn, or tool
loop reports the failure instead of a generic completion. Any pending
interaction registered through `uiSession` gets a notification; the current dsh
build registers approval and user questions (including plan review), and an
unknown future domain falls back to the generic `Input needed` copy.

A background Session's completion or failure notifies even while the page is
focused. The Session currently open in the page notifies only while the page is
hidden or the window is unfocused; pending-interaction notifications are not
gated by the main view. A notification is held for three seconds after a
background Session goes idle.

Tabs coordinate through local storage: a focused tab publishes the Session it
shows, other tabs suppress notifications for that Session, and one tab claims
each event so hidden tabs do not duplicate it. The client also fetches the
served boot manifest every 15 seconds and reloads itself when the plugin bundle
revision changes, so an open page cannot keep running stale notification code
after a hot update (the first release with this check still needs one manual
refresh). If a retry, queued continuation, or new pending input resumes
the session in that window, the notification is cancelled; this keeps transient
failures that immediately retry from producing an invalid notification.

Notifications appear only while the page is hidden or the window is unfocused,
and only after the browser grants notification permission. The page asks once on
the first click or keypress; grant it for the deployment origin. Clicking a
notification brings the dsh window back to the foreground and opens the notified
Session in this page. Subagent and removed
sessions are skipped, and an unknown or not-yet-listed Session is never guessed
into a notification. Set `notifications: false` in the plugin config to turn the
notification half off (the composer Enter rewrite stays active).

Limitations: this uses page Web Notifications, not Web Push. The dsh page must
stay open in a tab (it may be backgrounded); a fully closed browser receives
nothing. Permission requires a secure context, so use HTTPS or loopback, not
plain HTTP on a LAN address. Notification text includes the session title, so
lock-screen previews may expose it.

The data comes from the Host's durable session logs, read through
`ctx.sessionQuery` without activating any Agent. The plugin replays the same
provider usage samples the stock `tokenUsage` projection folds — one settlement
per Turn/step, with retried steps counting their replacement attempt — and skips
fork-inherited event prefixes so a forked Session does not double-count its
parent's usage. Subagent Sessions are included and attributed to the workspace
of their parent chain. Sessions not registered in a workspace fall back to a
per-directory row; Sessions with no directory at all share one "Other sessions"
row.

The first request scans the complete history and may take a few seconds; later
requests reuse a per-Session fold cache that the live `session/event` feed
invalidates. The page's **Refresh** button forces a full rescan. Usage is
attributed to the local day of the event that settled the billed sample, so a
Turn crossing midnight stays on the day it settled. Set `statsPage: false` to
remove both the sidebar page and its data route.

The page reads `GET /dsh-dev-plugins/stats/data?from=<ms>&to=<ms>&tz=<IANA>`
(`from`/`to` optional, `refresh=1` forces a rescan). The route is read-only and
applies the same trusted-authority and launch-token cookie checks as `/api`; it
returns only token totals, workspace paths, and day keys, never message content.

Settings → **Dev plugins** is a form with one switch per bundle feature, all on
by default: loopback page view, token sign-in page, browser notifications, token
usage page, composer Enter rewrite, and browser control. Writes go through the
Host configuration form, so they land in the profile patch as ordinary plugin
config and survive restarts.

Host-side switches are volatile config: the running plugin reads them live, so
the sign-in page and the statistics route follow a change without a restart,
including after a Host plugin reload.
Switches that change the browser half (notifications, the statistics entry, the
composer rewrite) need a page reload; the page shows a reload banner after a
write. Browser control is a boot-time MCP child process, so its switch needs a
`dsh web` restart.

readme.section: Composer: Enter inserts a line break
readme.text:
The dsh chat composer submits on Enter and inserts a line break on Shift+Enter.
This bundle flips the plain Enter key: it now inserts a line break, and a
message is sent with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter or the Send button. The rewrite targets the
composer's Lexical editor only — a plain Enter in any other input, and Enter
while a slash-command, mention, or file menu is open, keep their stock
behaviour, and IME composition is left alone. Turn it off with the
`composerNewline` switch on the settings page (or `composerNewline: false` in
the plugin config). While a session is running, the keyboard send
uses dsh's accelerated submit, so it does not follow the busy-Enter queue/steer
preference the Send button still honours.

The bundle also ships a Chrome extension plus a local bridge that exposes the
browser as dsh tools, so the model can drive your local Chrome during a session
with the same fidelity as DevTools: click, type, navigate, wait, screenshot,
read the DOM, run page JavaScript, inspect network traffic, and manage
cookies/storage. Tools appear as `mcp__browser__*` and the bridge is spawned by
the bundle's `mcp-browser` row — no extra MCP configuration.

Control is fully automatic: the bridge attaches the tab it needs and may switch
tabs, so anything open in that Chrome can be read or operated. Only install the
extension when you accept that scope. dsh's own approval prompts still apply
(each tool call may ask once; dsh has no allow-always rule), so pair this with
a permission preset you are comfortable with.

**Install.** The bridge needs nothing beyond the bundle, and the extension
connects with a built-in token — no pairing step. For the extension:

1. Open `chrome://extensions`, enable Developer mode, choose **Load unpacked**,
   and select the `extension/` directory of this package (for a profile
   install: `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-dev-plugins/extension`).
   Chrome asks for `debugger`, `tabs`, `storage`, `alarms`, and `downloads`.
2. Restart `dsh web` so the bundle's `mcp-browser` row spawns the bridge. The
   extension reconnects by itself; the popup shows **Connected** and the
   attached tabs. The popup's optional **Token override** field is only needed
   when the bridge sets `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_TOKEN`. Coming from 0.7.0/0.7.1:
   the old random 64-hex token is cleared once; a custom hex-shaped override
   has to be re-entered once.

Requires Chrome 120+ on the machine that runs `dsh web`; the debugger
attachment shows Chrome's "being controlled by automated test software" banner
while attached. The bridge binds `127.0.0.1` only.

**Tools** (all return JSON; screenshots also return an image block):

| tool | purpose |
|---|---|
| `tabs` | list, open, select, close tabs |
| `navigate` | URL, back, forward, reload; waits for load by default |
| `observe` | URL, title, page text, and interactive elements with stable `ref`s |
| `screenshot` | viewport, full page, element, or `ref` |
| `wait` | element, text, network idle, or timeout |
| `click` | real mouse click by `ref` (or CSS selector) |
| `type` | type text into a field, optionally clear first or submit |
| `key` | key chords such as `Control+A`, `Shift+Enter`, `Escape` |
| `scroll` | element or viewport |
| `dialog` | accept/dismiss `alert`/`confirm`/`prompt` |
| `evaluate` | run JavaScript in the page, return a JSON value |
| `network` | start/stop capture, list requests, fetch one response body (2 MB cap) |
| `upload` | set a file input from an allowed local directory |
| `download` | fetch a URL into the local download directory, or list recent Chrome downloads |
| `cookies` | get, set, clear cookies |
| `storage` | get, set, clear `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` |

Interactive tools accept `ref` first and fall back to a CSS `selector`;
`evaluate` is the escape hatch for everything else. A `ref` stays valid until
the next `observe`, a navigation, or a tab change, and a stale `ref` fails with
a message telling the model to observe again.

**Security and limits.** Everything is local: WebSocket on `127.0.0.1`, a
shared token (fixed built-in by default, overridable), and an
`Origin: chrome-extension://<id>` check (optionally pinned to an extension-id
allowlist — recommended when another local extension must not be able to
connect). Every tool call is appended to
`$DSH_HOME/browser-bridge/audit.jsonl` without secrets or typed text. `upload`
only reads real files under `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_UPLOAD_ROOTS` (default
`~/Downloads,~/Desktop`), `download op:"url"` writes only under
`DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DOWNLOAD_DIR` (default `~/Downloads/dsh-browser`) —
page-triggered downloads keep Chrome's own download folder. Screenshots are
returned as image blocks and never written, and network bodies stay in memory. Risky tools can be switched off individually
with `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DISABLE`, and `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE=0` exits the bridge
so no browser tools are registered. The settings page's **Browser control**
switch writes the same intent through the plugin config; the bridge reads it at
startup, so restart `dsh web` after changing it.

| variable | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE` | `1` | `0` disables the bridge and its tools (the settings switch has the same effect after a restart) |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_PORT` | `8790` | local WebSocket port |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_TOKEN` | built-in fixed value | token override for private deployments |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_HOME` | `$DSH_HOME/browser-bridge` | audit log |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_EXTENSION_ID` | empty | allowed extension ids |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_UPLOAD_ROOTS` | `~/Downloads,~/Desktop` | upload roots |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DOWNLOAD_DIR` | `~/Downloads/dsh-browser` | bridge-side download destination |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DISABLE` | empty | comma-separated disabled tools |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_NETWORK_LIMIT` | `500` | captured request ring buffer |

On a headless server there is no Chrome to attach, so leave the extension
uninstalled and the bridge idle (or set `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE=0`).
The package is a dsh **bundle**: `cordis.patch.yml` is a patch layer over `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`, and several seams are used.

1. **Trusted hosts — patch layer.** The `connection` row's `trustedHosts` gets the environment list concatenated onto the invocation list. The expression reads `ctx.get('webRuntime')` (dsh 0.2.0, which already carries the bind-derived LAN literals and CLI extras) or `ctx.get('webStartup')` (dsh 0.2.1); 0.2.0 provides both services, so runtime must win to keep a wildcard bind's LAN authorities. One patch covers both layouts. The Host/Origin fence and the `allowsRemoteAuthorities` classification are then upstream's own.
2. **Loopback view — index injection.** The host plugin listens to `webserver/index-inject` and adds one inline classic script to the served index:

`ClientTransportHooks.ownsHost` is upstream's flag for "this page owns the Host", documented as reserved for a shell that assembles its own transport; upstream also states that served pages never carry the global. This bundle sets it deliberately to obtain owner parity: `dsh-client-connection` reports the loopback view without changing the page's HTTP + WebSocket carrier. The guard leaves any real shell-provided transport untouched, and the script runs before the shell entry and every client plugin.
3. **Launch token — service field.** The plugin waits for `ctx.connection` and sets `connection.browserAuth.launchToken` before the loader settles, so both the printed authenticated URL and token validation use the pinned value. If a future dsh version hides that field, the plugin fails loudly instead of silently printing a random URL.
4. **Login form — index authorization.** The plugin wraps `connection.authorizeIndex`, the seam `dsh-host-frontend-static` calls before serving the index. Unauthenticated GET index requests from a trusted authority get the token form (`401` with HTML); requests that are authenticated, carry a valid token, come from an untrusted authority, or use another m

5. **Notifications — client plugin.** `package.json` declares `dsh.client` with
   `platform: web` and exports `./client`; `dsh-client-modules` serves the
   browser bundle to the page. The client subscribes to
   `ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus` through the `sessions` and `uiSession`
   services and raises local Web Notifications; `ctx.remote.$on('api-session/error')`
   supplies failure details for the next idle transition. The Host only injects
   the `__DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_NOTIFY__` feature flag from `config.notifications`.
6. **Token statistics — Host route plus client panel.** Each Session log is
   folded into provider usage settlements (`assistant/message`/`assistant/attempt`
   usage samples, replacement and retry aware) and cached per Session id. A
   `session/event` listener marks the Session dirty, so the next request rereads
   only what changed. The Host registers the exact route
   `/dsh-dev-plugins/stats/data` on `ctx.webServer` and guards it with
   `connection.isTrusted` and `connection.browserAuth.isAuthenticated`. The
   browser half registers a `main` panel and a `sidebar.panellist` entry; the
   Host injects `__DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_STATS__` from `config.statsPage`.

8. **Browser control — MCP bridge plus extension.** The bundle patch inserts a `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row (`mcp-browser`, `serverName: browser`) whose stdio command is the running Node interpreter and whose argument is `bridge/index.js`, resolved from `$DSH_HOME/profiles/$DSH_PROFILE/node_modules/dsh-dev-plugins/`. The bridge serves MCP tools and a localhost WebSocket relay; the MV3 extension connects to the relay, owns `chrome.debugger`, and forwards CDP commands and events. Tool calls and the page content they touch never leave the machine.

- **The launch token is the credential.** Anyone holding the printed `?token=` URL can obtain a session cookie and full owner access. Share it deliberately. A pinned token is a long-lived credential — never commit it. Changing `DSH_WEB_TOKEN` and restarting invalidates the old URL but does **not** revoke cookies already issued (they live for `cookieMaxAgeDays`, 30 days by default); clear the site's cookies, or remove the browser-session credential record and restart, to revoke them.
- **Trusted hosts are not authentication.** They only admit the authority to the Host/Origin fence; the signed session cookie still gates every RPC. Never expose the listener port to an untrusted network without TLS and a proxy you control.
- **Loopback parity is a privilege decision.** On dsh 0.2.0 it makes settings host-backed for authenticated remote browsers; on every version it exposes local-only UI affordances such as **Open configuration file**, which opens the settings document in the *host's* editor. Remote browsers already hold owner credentials, but operators who want the stock least-privilege view can set `loopback: false`.
- **The loopback view goes beyond a documented client contract.** Up

7. **Composer Enter — client capture listener.** The client half installs one capture-phase `keydown` listener on the page document. A plain Enter inside the composer's Lexical editor (`[data-composer-card]` containing `[data-lexical-editor="true"]`) is cancelled and replayed as the Shift+Enter chord the stock composer already maps to a line break; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter still submits. The rewrite is skipped while a slash-command, mention, or file menu (`[data-trigger-menu]`) is open, and during IME composition.

- Tested against dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, and `0.2.0-rc.2` (Web profile).
- Declared range: `engines.dsh >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0`. dsh 0.1.x is not supported or tested.
- On dsh 0.2.0 a profile-level wildcard bind (`webserver.host: 0.0.0.0`) derives LAN authorities; the patch preserves them, so the printed LAN URL works without extra trusted-host entries.
- The plugin row is Web-profile only; in a profile without a `connection` service the row stays inactive, so installing it there achieves nothing.
- `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@<version>` replaces the dsh install but not the profile: the plugin keeps working after a dsh upgrade. Restart `dsh web` to load a new dsh version.
- The token seam reads `connection.browserAuth.launchToken`. If dsh changes that shape, the plugin throws at boot when a token is configured; unset the token or update the plugin.
- Browser control needs Chrome 120+ with the extension loaded unpacked. The `debugger` permission shows Chrome's automation banner while a tab is attached. On a headless server there is no Chrome, so the bridge stays idle and the tools fail with `bridge_disconnected`.
- The patch resolves `bridge/index.js` from `$DSH_HOME` and `

```sh
npm install
npm test        # node:test unit tests for config, token resolution, index injection, usage folding, and route auth
```

End-to-end check on an isolated home (no effect on your real profile):

```sh
export DSH_HOME=$(mktemp -d)
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
DSH_WEB_TOKEN=dev-token DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS=dsh.test \
  dsh --profile web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3199 --no-open

一组以单个 bundle 安装的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）插件。当前版本让 dsh 的 Web UI 可以通过**非 localhost 地址**访问 —— 反向代理、SSH 隧道或局域网地址均可 —— 无需修改已安装的 dsh 源码，并附带浏览器通知、工作区 token 用量页，以及回车换行的输入框。

[English](./README.md)

| 问题 | 上游行为 | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| `/api` 的 Host/Origin 信任围栏 | 只接受 loopback、监听绑定的 IP 字面量和 `--trusted-host`；经代理的权威访问所有 RPC 返回 `403` | 把 `DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS` 中的权威追加进同一列表（`--trusted-host` 继续有效） |
| 页面视图（`connection.isLoopback`） | 仅由 `location.hostname` 判定；经代理的页面被当作非回环，dsh 0.2.0 下设置只存在于进程内存（Models 页报 `settings are unavailable in this browser`），所有版本都会隐藏打开宿主机配置文件的操作 | 注入 `__DSH_TRANSPORT__ = { ownsHost: true }` —— dsh 桌面壳使用的宿主自有传输钩子 —— 已认证页面因此呈现回环视图 |
| 启动令牌 | 每个进程随机生成，重启后只能从服务日志里找登录 URL | 通过 `DSH_WEB_TOKEN`（或插件配置）固定令牌，重启后登录 URL 不变 |
| 首次登录 | 直接打开裸地址返回纯文本 `401`，必须使用打印出来的 `?token=` URL | 裸地址上提供 HTML 令牌输入框（`loginPage`，默认开启），提交后仍走上游的令牌交换 |
| 后台提醒 | 标签页在后台时，任务完成或等待批准/回答都不可见 | 用浏览器通知提醒任务完成和待处理输入（`notifications`，默认开启） |
| Token 用量历史 | 聊天统计条只显示当前会话，没有跨会话或工作区视图 | 增加侧边栏 **Token 统计** 页，从宿主持久化会话日志按工作区和日期聚合 provider 计费 token（`statsPage`，默认开启） |
认证机制不变：浏览器仍需用启动令牌换取与权威绑定的签名会话 Cookie，每次 `/api` 请求仍先经过 Host/Origin 围栏。本插件只消除部署摩擦，不新增也不绕过访问控制。
```sh

readme.section: 从 GitHub 安装（公开仓库，无需构建）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/0xshawn/dsh-dev-plugins.git

dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-dev-plugins
```

之后重启 `dsh web`（dsh 在启动时加载 bundle）。确认插件行已生效：

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A6 'dsh-dev-plugins'
```

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-dev-plugins`，下次重启即恢复上游默认行为。

> **0.5.0 起改名。** 原包名为 `dsh-remote-access`；profile 行名与环境变量现为 `dsh-dev-plugins` 和 `DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS`。请先移除旧行再添加新行，并同步修改服务环境中的变量名。

如果现有部署是通过 patch 已安装的 dsh bundle 实现（固定启动令牌 + 强制回环判定），迁移步骤：

1. 安装脚本里不再执行 patch；`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@<version>` 之后不需要补 patch 步骤。
2. 按上面的方式把本 bundle 装进 `web` profile，重启 `dsh web`。
3. 保留部署原有的 `DSH_WEB_TOKEN`（变量名相同，直接沿用）；`--trusted-host` 可继续使用，也可改配 `DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS`。
4. 确认启动日志仍打印固定令牌：`dsh web: ...?token=<同一个令牌>`。

| 变量 | 取值 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS` | 逗号分隔的裸权威，如 `dsh.example.com,dsh.example.com:8443` | 追加到 `--trusted-host`；不带端口的条目匹配任意端口 |
| `DSH_WEB_TOKEN` | 非空启动令牌 | 固定登录令牌；为空或未设置时保持上游的每进程随机令牌 |

两者都可以放在 systemd 的 `Environment=`/`EnvironmentFile=`、launchd 的 `EnvironmentVariables`、Docker 环境变量或 shell profile 中。习惯命令行参数时继续用 `--trusted-host` 即可；表达式会把这些环境权威追加到命令行列表之后。注意 patch 层会整体替换 `connection.config`：若另一个层（或更靠后的 profile patch）覆盖了 `connection`，需要在那里重新写上 `trustedHosts`（否则环境权威会丢失），并补齐仍需保留的键，例如 `cookieMaxAgeDays`、`recovery`。

```sh
DSH_WEB_TOKEN="$(cat /etc/dsh/web-token)" \
DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS="dsh.example.com" \
dsh web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3080 --no-open
```
非法权威（带 scheme、路径、userinfo 或补零端口）会在启动时以上游的校验错误中止，而不是被静默忽略。

需要按 profile 覆盖时，编辑 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 中的 `dsh-dev-plugins` 行：

```yaml
- id: dsh-dev-plugins
  config:
    # false 表示保持上游按权威判定的页面视图。
    loopback: true

设置 → **开发插件** 提供同样的开关表单，不必手改此文件。

readme.section: 首次登录：不用带 token 的 URL
readme.text:
未认证的浏览器直接打开裸部署地址时，会看到一个简单的登录表单，而不是纯文本 `401`。表单把令牌提交回相对的 index 路径（`GET ./?token=...`），因此上游的令牌交换、签名 Cookie、反代挂载前缀和跳转到干净 URL 的逻辑全部照旧。令牌错误时表单重新显示并给出错误提示；令牌正确则完成登录。

只有请求权威已经通过部署的 Host/Origin 围栏（loopback、监听绑定字面量，或 `DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS`/`--trusted-host` 中的权威）时才会返回表单；不受信任的权威仍得到纯文本 `401`，因此 DNS rebinding 或外部主机无法借此收集令牌。令牌仍然出现在查询串里（与打印的 URL 相同），也仍然是唯一凭据；表单没有引入第二套密码存储，也没有绕过认证。若前置代理已有自己的登录页，可设 `loginPage: false` 恢复上游 `401`。

`--public-url https://dsh.example.com/` 负责对外公布浏览器使用的地址（打印的 URL、`DSH_WEB_URL`、运行时上下文），本插件不改变这一点。代理仍需：

- 原样保留浏览器侧的 `Host`（围栏逐字比较）；
- 转发前剥掉挂载前缀；
- 带上 `Upgrade`/`Connection` 转发 WebSocket 升级；
- 把 Cookie 的 `Path` 重写到挂载点，并在 HTTPS 侧补 `Secure`。

完整清单见上游文档 [Publish the Web UI behind a reverse proxy](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/user/guide/public-deployments.md)。TLS 终结、网络隔离、谁能访问监听端口，仍由运维方负责。

bundle 还带一个手写、无需构建的浏览器客户端：监听 Session 状态源，在以下情况发浏览器通知：

- 顶层会话从运行中变为空闲 —— `任务完成：<标题>`；
- 同一次空闲转变前有 Host agent 错误 —— `任务失败：<标题>`，正文取错误首行；
- 会话开始等待批准、计划确认或回答 —— `需要批准` / `需要确认计划` / `需要你的输入`。

失败信息来自转发的 `api-session/error` 事件，并与随后的空闲转变配对，因此模型调用失败、回合中止或工具循环报错会显示失败原因，而不是笼统的“任务完成”。任何通过 `uiSession` 注册的待处理交互都会触发通知；当前 dsh 版本注册的是批准和用户提问（含计划确认），未来未知的交互类型会回退到通用的 `需要你的输入` 文案。

后台会话的完成/失败通知即使页面在前台也会发出；当前页面正在查看的主会话则只在页面隐藏或窗口失焦时通知。待审批/提问不受主视图限制。会话空闲后，完成/失败通知会延迟 3 秒。

多个标签页通过 localStorage 协调：聚焦标签页发布自己正在查看的会话，其他标签页对该会话不再发通知，并用认领机制避免隐藏标签页重复通知。客户端每 15 秒获取一次服务端 boot manifest，插件 bundle 版本变化时自动 reload，避免热更新后旧页面继续跑旧通知逻辑（首次引入该检查的这一版仍需手动刷新一次）。如果窗口期内会话因重试、排队的后续消息或新的待处理输入重新运行，通知会被取消，避免“失败后马上重试”这类无效通知。

只有页面不可见或窗口失去焦点时才通知，且必须先获得浏览器的通知权限。页面会在第一次点击/按键时请求一次权限（按来源授权）。点击通知会把 dsh 窗口切到前台，并在当前页面打开被通知的会话。子代理会话和已移除会话会被跳过，未知或尚未出现在列表中的会话不会被猜测成通知。插件配置 `notifications: false` 可关闭通知半边（输入框回车改写仍然生效）。
限制：这里用的是页面级 Web Notification，不是 Web Push。dsh 页面必须保持打开（可以切到后台）；浏览器完全关闭后不会收到通知。通知权限需要安全上下文，因此使用 HTTPS 或 loopback，局域网纯 HTTP 不行。通知正文包含会话标题，锁屏预览可能暴露它。

侧边栏新增 **Token 统计** 入口，打开后包含：

- 时间预设（今天、近 7 天、近 30 天、全部、自定义），日界按浏览器 IANA 时区计算；控件配色随当前浅色/深色主题变化；
- 按天柱状图展示 provider 计费 token；
- 汇总卡片：总数、未缓存输入、输出、缓存读、缓存写；
- 工作区表格：会话数与同样的四列 token。

数据来自宿主持久化的会话日志，通过 `ctx.sessionQuery` 读取且不会激活任何 Agent。插件重放与上游 `tokenUsage` 投影相同的 provider usage 样本：每个 Turn/step 一次结算，重试的 step 按替换后的 attempt 计入；fork 继承的事件前缀会被跳过，避免子会话重复计算父会话用量。子代理会话计入统计，并沿父会话链归到对应工作区；未登记工作区的会话按目录单列，没有目录的会话归入“其他会话”。

首次打开会扫描全部历史，可能需要几秒；之后的请求复用按会话的折叠缓存，由实时 `session/event` 标脏增量更新。页面上的 **刷新** 按钮会强制全量重扫。用量归属于结算事件所在的本地日期，因此跨午夜的 Turn 计入结算当天。设置 `statsPage: false` 可同时移除侧边栏页面和数据路由。

页面读取 `GET /dsh-dev-plugins/stats/data?from=<毫秒>&to=<毫秒>&tz=<IANA>`（`from`/`to` 可选，`refresh=1` 强制重扫）。该路由只读，并执行与 `/api` 相同的受信任权威和启动令牌 Cookie 校验；只返回 token 总量、工作区 id/标题/路径、日期键和扫描元数据，不返回消息内容。

设置 → **开发插件** 是一张开关表单，每项 bundle 功能一个开关，默认全部打开：回环页面视图、令牌登录页、浏览器通知、Token 统计页、输入框回车换行、浏览器控制。写入走宿主配置表单，因此会作为普通插件配置写进 profile patch，重启后仍然保留。

宿主侧开关是 volatile 配置：运行中的插件实时读取，因此登录页和统计路由改完立即生效，无需重启，Host 插件重载后也保持一致。作用于浏览器半边的开关（通知、统计入口、回车换行）需要刷新页面，页面在写入后会显示刷新提示条。浏览器控制是启动时拉起的 MCP 子进程，必须重启 `dsh web` 才生效。

dsh 聊天输入框原本回车发送、Shift+回车换行。本 bundle 把普通回车改为换行，发送改用 Cmd/Ctrl+回车或发送按钮。改写只作用于聊天输入框的 Lexical 编辑器：其他输入框的回车、以及斜杠命令/提及/文件菜单打开时的回车都保持上游行为；被改写的按键不会发送消息，输入法组词期间也不处理。可在设置页关闭 `composerNewline` 开关（或在插件配置里设 `composerNewline: false`）。会话运行中时，键盘发送走 dsh 的加速提交路径，因此不会遵循发送按钮仍然遵循的排队/插话偏好。

bundle 还带一个 Chrome 扩展和一个本地 bridge，把浏览器变成 dsh 工具：会话中模型可以像 DevTools 一样操作你本机的 Chrome —— 点击、输入、导航、等待、截图、读 DOM、执行页面 JS、看网络请求、读写 Cookie/存储。工具名形如 `mcp__browser__*`，bridge 由 bundle 的 `mcp-browser` 行自动拉起，不需要额外 MCP 配置。

控制是全自动的：bridge 按需 attach 目标 tab，也可以自由切 tab，所以该 Chrome 里打开的任何页面都可能被读取或操作。只在你接受这个范围时安装扩展。dsh 自身的审批仍然生效（每条工具调用可能询问一次；dsh 没有 allow-always 规则），请配合你认可的权限预设使用。

**安装。** bridge 随 bundle 装好即可；扩展使用内置固定 token，无需配对。扩展：

1. 打开 `chrome://extensions`，启用开发者模式，选 **加载已解压的扩展程序**，选中本包的 `extension/` 目录（通过 profile 安装时为 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-dev-plugins/extension`）。Chrome 会请求 `debugger`、`tabs`、`storage`、`alarms`、`downloads` 权限。
2. 重启 `dsh web`，让 bundle 的 `mcp-browser` 行拉起 bridge。扩展会自动重连；弹窗显示 **Connected** 与已 attach 的 tab 即成功。只有 bridge 设置 `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_TOKEN` 时才需要在弹窗的“Token override”里填同样的值。从 0.7.0/0.7.1 升级时，扩展里旧的随机 64 位十六进制 token 会自动清除一次；自定义的十六进制 override 需要重新填一次。

需要运行 `dsh web` 的机器上有 Chrome 120+；attach 期间 Chrome 会显示“正在由自动化测试软件控制”提示条。bridge 只监听 `127.0.0.1`。

**工具**（均返回 JSON；截图额外返回 image 内容块）：

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `tabs` | 列出、新建、切换、关闭 tab |
| `navigate` | URL、后退、前进、刷新；默认等待加载完成 |
| `observe` | 返回 URL、标题、页面文本，以及带稳定 `ref` 的可交互元素 |
| `screenshot` | 视口、整页、元素或 `ref` 截图 |
| `wait` | 等元素、等文本、等网络空闲或超时 |
| `click` | 按 `ref`（或 CSS selector）真实鼠标点击 |
| `type` | 向输入框输入文本，可先清空或提交 |
| `key` | 组合键，如 `Control+A`、`Shift+Enter`、`Escape` |
| `scroll` | 元素或视口滚动 |
| `dialog` | 处理 `alert`/`confirm`/`prompt` |
| `evaluate` | 在页面执行 JavaScript，返回 JSON 值 |
| `network` | 开始/停止抓包、列请求、取单个响应体（上限 2MB） |
| `upload` | 从允许的本地目录为文件输入框选文件 |
| `download` | 把 URL 抓取到本地下载目录，或列出 Chrome 最近的下载 |
| `cookies` | 读取、设置、清除 Cookie |
| `storage` | 读取、设置、清除 `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` |
交互类工具优先用 `ref`，回退 CSS `selector`；`evaluate` 是一切兜底。`ref` 在下一次 `observe`、页面导航或切 tab 后失效，过期会返回提示让模型重新 observe。

**安全与限制。** 全部本地：`127.0.0.1` 上的 WebSocket、共享 token（默认内置固定值，可覆盖）、`Origin: chrome-extension://<id>` 校验（可选按扩展 ID 白名单收紧，建议其他本机扩展不可信时启用）。每次工具调用写入 `$DSH_HOME/browser-bridge/audit.jsonl`，不记录密钥与输入文本。`upload` 只能读 `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_UPLOAD_ROOTS`（默认 `~/Downloads,~/Desktop`）下的真实文件，`download op:"url"` 只写 `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DOWNLOAD_DIR`（默认 `~/Downloads/dsh-browser`）——页面自身触发的下载仍走 Chrome 的下载目录设置；截图只作为 image 内容块返回、不落盘；网络响应体只在内存。危险工具可用 `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DISABLE` 单独关闭；`DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE=0` 让 bridge 直接退出，不注册任何浏览器工具。设置页的 **浏览器控制** 开关通过插件配置表达同样意图，bridge 在启动时读取，因此修改后要重启 `dsh web`。

| 变量 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE` | `1` | `0` 关闭 bridge 与全部浏览器工具（设置页开关重启后等效） |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_PORT` | `8790` | 本地 WebSocket 端口 |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_TOKEN` | 内置固定值 | 私有部署的 token 覆盖 |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_HOME` | `$DSH_HOME/browser-bridge` | 审计目录 |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_EXTENSION_ID` | 空 | 允许的扩展 ID（逗号分隔） |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_UPLOAD_ROOTS` | `~/Downloads,~/Desktop` | 上传允许根目录 |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DOWNLOAD_DIR` | `~/Downloads/dsh-browser` | bridge 侧下载目录 |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_DISABLE` | 空 | 禁用的工具（逗号分隔） |
| `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE_NETWORK_LIMIT` | `500` | 网络抓包环形缓冲大小 |
无头服务器上没有 Chrome 可 attach，不装扩展、让 bridge 空转即可（或设 `DSH_BROWSER_BRIDGE=0`）。

本包是一个 dsh **bundle**：`cordis.patch.yml` 是叠加在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 之上的 patch 层，用到以下扩展点。

1. **信任权威 —— patch 层。** 在 `connection` 行的 `trustedHosts` 上把环境变量列表拼接到命令行列表之后。表达式优先读取 0.2.0 的 `ctx.get('webRuntime')`（其中已包含通配绑定推导出的 LAN 字面量与命令行附加项），再回退到 0.2.1 的 `ctx.get('webStartup')`；0.2.0 同时提供这两个服务，因此必须优先 runtime，否则会丢掉通配绑定的 LAN 权威。一份 patch 覆盖两种布局。Host/Origin 围栏与 `allowsRemoteAuthorities` 判定都交回上游实现。
2. **回环视图 —— index 注入。** 宿主插件监听 `webserver/index-inject`，向返回的 index 注入一段内联经典脚本：

`ClientTransportHooks.ownsHost` 是上游"本页面拥有 Host"的标志，但文档将其保留给自行组装 transport 的 shell，并声明服务端返回的页面从不携带该全局变量。本 bundle 有意设置它来获得 owner 视图：`dsh-client-connection` 据此报告回环视图，但页面仍使用正常的 HTTP + WebSocket 传输。守卫语句不会覆盖真实 shell 提供的 transport，脚本在 shell 入口和全部客户端插件之前执行。
3. **启动令牌 —— 服务字段。** 插件等待 `ctx.connection` 就绪，在 Loader 结算前设置 `connection.browserAuth.launchToken`，打印的认证 URL 与令牌校验因此统一使用固定值。若未来 dsh 隐藏该字段，插件会显式报错，而不是悄悄退回随机 URL。
4. **登录表单 —— index 授权。** 插件包装 `connection.authorizeIndex`：`dsh-host-frontend-static` 在返回 index 前调用它。来自受信任权威、未认证的 GET index 请求得到令牌表单（内容为 HTML 的 `401`）；已认证、携带有效令牌、来自不受信任权威或非 GET 的请求都交回上游实现。插件卸载时恢复原方法。若未来 dsh 移除该方法，表单会静默禁用，裸地址恢复上游纯文本 `401`，其余功能不受影响。

5. **通知 —— 客户端插件。** `package.json` 声明 `dsh.client`（`platform: web`）并导出 `./client`；`dsh-client-modules` 把浏览器 bundle 发给页面。客户端通过 `sessions` 与 `uiSession` 服务订阅 `ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus`，在本地发 Web Notification；`ctx.remote.$on('api-session/error')` 为下一次空闲转变提供失败详情。宿主侧只注入 `config.notifications` 对应的 `__DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_NOTIFY__` 开关。
6. **Token 统计 —— 宿主路由加客户端页面。** 每个会话日志被折叠成 provider usage 结算记录（`assistant/message`/`assistant/attempt` 的 usage 样本，处理替换与重试），并按会话 id 缓存。`session/event` 监听器把会话标脏，下次请求只重读变化部分。宿主在 `ctx.webServer` 上注册精确路由 `/dsh-dev-plugins/stats/data`，并用 `connection.isTrusted` 与 `connection.browserAuth.isAuthenticated` 校验。浏览器半边注册 `main` 面板与 `sidebar.panellist` 入口；宿主根据 `config.statsPage` 注入 `__DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_STATS__` 开关。

8. **浏览器控制 —— MCP bridge 加扩展。** bundle patch 插入一行 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`（`mcp-browser`，`serverName: browser`），stdio 命令是当前 Node 解释器，参数是按 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/$DSH_PROFILE/node_modules/dsh-dev-plugins/` 解析出的 `bridge/index.js`。bridge 提供 MCP 工具和本机 WebSocket 中继；MV3 扩展连中继、持有 `chrome.debugger`、转发 CDP 命令与事件。工具调用及其触碰的页面内容都不离开本机。

- **启动令牌就是凭据。** 持有打印出来的 `?token=` URL 即可换取会话 Cookie 并获得完整 owner 权限。请谨慎分发；固定令牌是长期凭据，绝不能提交到仓库。修改 `DSH_WEB_TOKEN` 并重启只会让旧 URL 失效，**不会**吊销已经签发的 Cookie（默认有效期 `cookieMaxAgeDays` 为 30 天）；要真正吊销，请清除该站点的 Cookie，或删除 browser-session 凭据记录后重启。
- **信任权威不等于认证。** 它只让该权威通过 Host/Origin 围栏；签名会话 Cookie 仍把守每个 RPC。不要把监听端口暴露到不受信任的网络；需要时用 TLS 和自控代理。
- **回环视图是权限决定。** dsh 0.2.0 下它让已认证远程浏览器的设置改为写入宿主机；所有版本下它会暴露仅限本机的界面操作，例如 **Open configuration file** 会在**宿主机**的编辑器里打开设置文件。远程浏览器本来就持有 owner 凭据；希望保持上游最小权限视图的运维方可以设置 `loopback: false`。
- **回环视图超出了文档化的客户端契约。** 上游把 `ownsHost` 保留给自行组装 transport 的 shell，并声明服务端返回的页面从不携带该全局变量；本 bundle 有意设置它。当前 dsh 的所有消费方都只把它用于 `isLoopback`，但未来或第三方客户端插件可能把它当作宿主所有权的证明。设置 `loopback: false` 可消除该暴露面。
- **纯 HTTP 会泄露令牌。** 在代理侧或通过 `--tls-cert/--tls-key` 终结 TLS；Cookie 的 `Secure` 行为见上游文档。
- **通知会在系统通知/锁屏上显示会话标题。** 权限按浏览器来源授予；对共享屏幕或锁屏环境敏感时可用 `notifications: false` 关闭。
- **登录表单不做限流。** 它只是把同一个高熵启动令牌的输入入口暴露出来；对公网端点仍建议在代理层做限流。Host/Origin 围栏拒绝的权威永远不会看到表单。
- **统计路由会暴露用量元数据。** 它与 `/api` 使用同一套启动令牌 Cookie 和受信任权威围栏；返回内容只有按工作区/按天的 token 总量和工作区路径，不含提示词、回复或工具参数。持有 owner 凭据的人本来就能看到完整界面；`statsPage: false` 可移除该路由。
- **不要新增会拦截内联脚本的 CSP。** 回环视图行是一段内联经典脚本；dsh 自身的启动全局变量已经要求内联脚本权限，但代理注入的不含 `'unsafe-inline'`（或未用 nonce 覆盖

7. **输入框回车 —— 客户端捕获监听。** 客户端半边在页面 document 上安装一个捕获阶段的 `keydown` 监听器。位于聊天输入框 Lexical 编辑器内（`[data-composer-card]` 中的 `[data-lexical-editor="true"]`）的普通回车会被取消，并重放成上游已经映射为换行的 Shift+回车；Cmd/Ctrl+回车仍然发送。斜杠命令、提及或文件菜单（`[data-trigger-menu]`）打开时，以及输入法组词期间，不执行改写。

- 已在 dsh `0.2.1-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.3` 与 `0.2.0-rc.2` 的 Web profile 上验证。
- 声明范围：`engines.dsh >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0`。dsh 0.1.x 不受支持，也未测试。
- dsh 0.2.0 中 profile 级通配绑定（`webserver.host: 0.0.0.0`）会推导出 LAN 权威；本 patch 会保留它们，因此打印出的 LAN URL 无需额外 trusted-host 即可使用。
- 插件行仅适用于 Web profile；没有 `connection` 服务的 profile 中该行保持 inactive，安装也不会生效。
- `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@<version>` 升级 dsh 不会改动 profile，插件继续可用；升级后重启 `dsh web` 即加载新版本。
- 固定令牌依赖 `connection.browserAuth.launchToken` 字段。若 dsh 改变该结构，配置了令牌时插件会在启动阶段报错；取消令牌配置或升级插件即可。
- 浏览器控制需要 Chrome 120+ 并以“加载已解压”方式装扩展；attach 期间因 `debugger` 权限会显示 Chrome 自动化提示条。无头服务器没有 Chrome，bridge 空转，工具返回 `bridge_disconnected`。
- patch 按 `$DSH_HOME` 与 `$DSH_PROFILE` 解析 `bridge/index.js`；若启动 `dsh web` 时没有这两个变量，则回退到 `~/.dsh` 和 `web` profile。用其他 profile 名时需要设置这两个变量（上游 CLI 会导出它们）。
- 输入框回车改写依赖 dsh 内部 DOM 标记（`[data-composer-card]`、`[data-lexical-editor="true"]`、`[data-trigger-menu]`）。若未来 dsh 改名，监听器找不到输入框便静默失效，恢复上游“回车发送”，不会破坏页面。
- 登录表单包装 `connection.authorizeIndex` 并读取 `browserAuth.isAuthenticated`。若未来 dsh 移除二者，表单会被跳过，裸地址恢复上游纯文本 `401`，插件其余功能继续工作。
- 浏览器通知依赖客户端模块系统、`ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus` 与 `ctx.sessions`；若未来 dsh 移除其中任一项，客户端半边会静默失效，宿主半边继续工作。通知要求页面保持打开，没有 service worker 或 push

```sh
npm install
npm test        # node:test：配置、令牌解析、index 注入、用量折叠与路由鉴权单元测试
```

隔离 home 的端到端验证（不影响真实 profile）：

```sh
export DSH_HOME=$(mktemp -d)
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
DSH_WEB_TOKEN=dev-token DSH_DEV_PLUGINS_TRUSTED_HOSTS=dsh.test \
  dsh --profile web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3199 --no-open
